channel.title: Whisper Radar — TSCHECH Labs
channel.description: A public research journal on stock rumors, hype, and evidence. Opening post available; live findings will follow when the data is ready.

item.title: Fifty voices can still be one source
item.description: The opening post introduces Whisper Radar's experiment: trace how stock stories spread, check their evidence, and keep a visible record of the wrong calls. Includes a clearly labeled fictional example; no measured stock findings or validated model exists yet.
